_notes: Gemma 4 31B Instruct (dense). Source: model README at
sliding (window=1024) per 1x global, K=V on global layers + p-RoPE so
KV cache stays tiny even at 256k context. Reasoning is configurable;
vllm exposes the gemma4 reasoning parser.
Single A100 80GB sizing: ~62GB weights, ~18GB free. Empirically vLLM
needs ~12.7GB KV cache at 131072 ctx but only ~9.7GB is free post-
weights at gpu_memory_utilization=0.92, so we cap max_model_len at 90112
(just below vLLM's auto-suggested 91776 ceiling for this footprint).
count scales near-linearly with the remaining token budget.
